title: Legal Metrology (General) Rules, 2011 - Seventh Schedule, Heading A (Non-automatic weighing instruments), as amended up to G.S.R. 568(E) dt. 03-07-2026

documents.ref: G.S.R. 71(E) dt. 07-02-2011 (LM General Rules 2011), Seventh Schedule Heading A
G.S.R. 568(E) dt. 03-07-2026 (LM General Fourth Amendment Rules 2026) - Heading A Pt II 9(2)(ii) substitution

differences_from_base.topic: Creep and return to zero: classes
differences_from_base.profile: Classes I, II, III (TODO-VERIFY with RRSL)

differences_from_base.base: Limiting value of the level indicator; 50/1000 when there is no level indicator or tilt sensor (R76-1 3.9.1.1)
differences_from_base.profile: 2/1000 or the level-indicator limit, whichever is greater; 5 % when there is no level indicator

differences_from_base.topic: Tilting at no load, class II
differences_from_base.base: 2 e limit applies to class II used for direct sales (R76-2 form 8)
differences_from_base.profile: 2 e limit does not apply to class II
Standard weights >= 50 % of Max; 1/3 of Max if repeatability <= 0.3 e, 1/5 if <= 0.2 e

differences_from_base.base: Class IIII exempt unless used for commercial transactions; initial range > 20 % allowed with a supplementary weighing test (R76-1 4.5.1, A.4.4.2)
differences_from_base.profile: 4 % and 20 % limits for every class; no wider initial range
differences_from_base.clause: Hdg A Pt II 4 (zero-setting devices: Maximum effect)

differences_from_base.topic: Zero-setting accuracy with an auxiliary indicating device
differences_from_base.clause: Hdg A Pt II 4 (zero-setting devices: Accuracy)

differences_from_base.base: 5 C test when the low limit is <= 0 C; absolute humidity <= 20 g/m3 at the high temperature (R76-1 A.5.3.1)
differences_from_base.profile: 5 C test when the low limit is below 10 C (gazette: 'or'; the engine requires both); absolute humidity <= 20 g/m3 at every temperature

accuracy_classes.name: Special accuracy
notes: For e < 1 mg in class I, e shall be taken as 1 mg for verification/inspection (Table 17 note)
n may be < 50 000 when d < 0.1 mg (3(5)(v))

static_temperatures.abs_humidity_note: Hdg A 9(13)(i): absolute humidity <= 20 g/m3 unless the operating manual gives different specifications
static_temperatures.note: TODO-VERIFY: gazette reads 'at the specified low temperature or at a temperature of 5 C if the specified low temperature is below 10 C' (OIML R76-1 A.5.3.1: and at 5 C if the low temperature is <= 0 C). Engine requires both the low temperature and 5 C (the stricter reading); lab to confirm with RRSL.

tilting.limit_rule: greater of 2/1000 and the limiting value marked on / indicated by the level indicator

stable_equilibrium_e.clause: Hdg A Pt II 4 (stable equilibrium) / R76-1 A.4.12

span_stability.clause: Hdg A Pt II 5(3)(iii) / Annexure A para 4

damp_heat.clause: Hdg A Pt II 5(3)(ii) / Annexure A 2(2)

non_self.clause: Hdg A Pt II 3(8)(i) read with 6(1)

substitution.clause: Hdg A Pt II 9(2)(ii) as substituted by G.S.R. 568(E) dt. 03-07-2026

weighing_test_min_loads.clause: Hdg A Pt II 9(3); type evaluation per R76-1 A.4.4.1

time_tests_classes.note: TODO-VERIFY: gazette text reads 'class I, II or III' (OIML R76-1 3.9.4 reads II, III, IIII). Engine follows the gazette; lab to confirm with RRSL.

verdict_policy.clause: Lab decision rule (ILAC-G8); Hdg A itself is a simple acceptance rule

variants.digital: extra load 1.4 d must change indication by d (no d >= 5 mg exemption)
variants.analog: extra load |mpe| gives displacement >= 0.7 x extra load
variants.non_self: extra load 1.0 |mpe| gives movement as per 6(1)

T09.pass: no-load |dI| <= 2 e (not class II); loaded |Ec| <= mpe; tilt = max(2/1000, level-indicator limit) or 5% if no level indicator

T12.pass: abs(Ec) <= mpe at -15% / +10% voltage and -2% / +2% frequency

T13.clause: Hdg A Pt II 5(3)(iv) / Annexure A

T14.clause: Hdg A Pt II 5(3)(ii) / Annexure A 2(2)

T15.clause: Hdg A Pt II 5(3)(iii) / Annexure A 4

T18.clause: Hdg A Pt II 4 (zero-setting devices: Maximum effect, Accuracy)
T18.pass: initial zero-setting range <= 20 % Max; zero-setting + zero-tracking <= 4 % Max (all classes); |E0| after zero-setting <= 0.25 e, or 0.5 d with an auxiliary indicating device

T19.pass: abs(Ec) <= mpe at the reference, high, low (and 5 C if low < 10 C) and reference temperatures; absolute humidity <= 20 g/m3

T17.clause: Hdg A Pt II 4 / 7 (markings, sealing); software items per OIML R 76-1 5.5 / Annex G (no software clause in Hdg A)
